title: Stone Maps (Ruttier for the Dispossessed) Opening Reception
description: Opening reception for artist Kiyan Williams's public installation at Copp's Hill Terrace, marking the start of their 2026–27 residency with Boston Ujima Project and the Center for Art, Invention & Uncommon Practice (CAIUP). Live music and viewing, opening remarks and poetry, dinner, and a dance party across the afternoon and evening. Open to the public.
